$comment: Schema for a document in the blog_questions queue. Adapt collection/table name to your stack.

example.question: How much does it cost to rent a car in Miami?

fields.question: string, required - the exact question to answer
fields.status: enum: queued | generating | published | failed | skipped
fields.postId: string | null - id of the published post
fields.metadata: object | null - optional GSC/metrics context for the research step

rules.daily_cap_per_track: enforce per-track daily publish caps separately
rules.retry: failed items stay in queue and retry next cycle; do not drop
rules.dedup: normalize question (lowercase/trim) before insert to prevent duplicates
